item.title: The most broken fighting game characters of 2025 highlighted by Diaphone
item.description: <p>2025 has proven itself to be an interesting year for fighting games. There have been a number of fighters that have been relevant to fans and tournament competitors this year.</p> <p>Even though developers have become better at balancing compared to older times, the very nature of the genre means that they will ultimately have to emphasize character traits more so than keeping the game perfectly balanced.</p>

item.title: Street Fighter 6's new classic Battle HUDs aren't free, so here's how much it would cost you to pick them all up
item.description: <p>Street Fighter 6 finally added new DLC after months of waiting, though, it probably wasn't what fans were expecting.</p> <p>Capcom brought a new <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/10/street-fighter-hud-feature/">Battle HUD Settings feature</a> to the game in its <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/14/balance-changes-street-fighter-6/">latest update</a>, which allows players to change up what they're looking at in the heat of a match.</p>

item.title: Guilty Gear Strive collaboration announced with Eternal Return
item.description: <p>Guilty Gear Strive recently received its <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/aug/25/lucy-interesting-outros-ggstrive-video/">first crossover DLC character in Lucy from Cyberpunk: Edgerunners</a>, and now their own fighters are hopping over to a different genre entirely.</p> <p>Nimble Neuron and SapStaR Games announced the Eternal Return x Guilty Gear Strive collaboration coming to their game.</p>

item.title: Broski details 'the weirdest buff in A.K.I. history' which was in latest Street Fighter 6 patch... and actually costs money to be able to use
item.description: <p>We recently got a new patch for Street Fighter 6 for which you can find the patch notes <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/14/balance-changes-street-fighter-6/">here</a>.</p> <p>It was not a major patch by any means and most of the changes were focused on Elena and Sagat, and as you may notice when looking at the patch notes, A.K.I. reportedly received no changes at all, and she indeed didn't.
